```css
  background: var(--instui-color-background-interactive-action-primary-base);
  border-color: var(--instui-color-stroke-interactive-action-primary-base);

  /* hover/active/disabled states with primary tokens */
}
```

**Subsequent button styling** (line 238):
```css

  /* hover/active/disabled with tertiary tokens */
}
```

**Current approach:** Uses `:first-of-type` + sibling combinator (`~`) pattern. First button gets primary color tokens; subsequent buttons get tertiary ghost tokens.

**File:** [formats/components/src/components/alert/alert.css](formats/components/src/components/alert/alert.css#L280-L330)

- Primary buttons use standard action tokens: `--instui-color-background-interactive-action-primary-base`
- Secondary buttons use tertiary tokens: `--instui-component-base-button-tertiary-hover-border-color`, etc.

**Alert's approach:** Uses `:not(:has(+ .pfx-button))` (button with NO following sibling = primary) and `:has(+ .pfx-button)` (button WITH following sibling = secondary) pattern. Token sets vary by context (floating uses "inverse" / "inverse-ghost"; inline/warning uses standard primary / tertiary).
